# Awais Mehboob — Full-Stack Developer, AI Engineer & Automation Specialist

## Who I Am

Awais Mehboob is a full-stack developer and AI engineer based in Pakistan with 7+ years of professional experience. He has delivered 500+ projects across Fiverr, Upwork, Truelancer, and direct clients worldwide, specializing in custom AI agent development, agentic AI systems, voice bots, e-commerce, and automation.

## What I Do

### Core Services
- **AI Agent Development** — Multi-agent systems using CrewAI, LangChain, AutoGen. Autonomous pipelines that plan, reason, and execute complex workflows.
- **AI Voice Agent Development** — VAPI-powered voice bots for dental clinics, customer service, sales, and appointment booking. Integrates with Twilio, ElevenLabs, OpenAI.
- **Full-Stack Web Development** — React, Next.js, Node.js, Python/FastAPI, PHP/Laravel. Complete end-to-end web applications.
- **E-Commerce Development** — Custom Shopify themes, headless commerce, WooCommerce, Shopify-ERPNext integrations, composable architecture.
- **Automation & Bots** — WhatsApp bots, Telegram bots, trading bots (Polymarket), social media automation, web scraping, n8n workflows.
- **DevOps & Cloud** — Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines, Wazuh SIEM security.
- **Chrome Extensions** — Manifest v3 extensions for lead generation, video translation, productivity.

### Specializations
- Agentic AI (CrewAI, LangChain, AutoGen, custom tool-calling)
- VAPI voice agent systems (dental, customer service, sales)
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems with ChromaDB, pgvector
- Shopify composable/headless commerce
- Local LLM deployment (Ollama, DeepSeek-R1, Llama3)
- Real-time AI (streaming responses, voice-to-voice pipelines)
